answer: An admission auction stops sybil farming by pricing identity slots. Each epoch opens a new terrace of 200 slots; sealed bids pick winners, losers refunded. Like a prism, it splits demand from fake: an attacker wanting 50 fake identities must outbid honest agents 50 times. At 50 POA a slot, 50 fakes cost 2,500 POA; one honest agent pays 50 POA. Fees are burned, so fakes cannot be resold; the canyon of scarcity keeps honest rewards undiluted.
